description: Real-time production monitoring for the AQI Forecast API. Covers model health, prediction throughput & latency, live data pipeline freshness, per-city breakdown, and data drift detection. Refresh: 15s.

panels.description: 1 = API metrics endpoint reachable; 0 = backend is down.
panels.title: Backend status

panels.description: Whether the AQI LightGBM model is loaded in memory. 0 means all predict requests will fail.

panels.description: Fraction of predict requests that returned an error in the last 5 minutes.

panels.description: Prediction success rate over last 5 minutes (1 - error rate). SLA target ≥ 99.5%. Green ≥ 99.5%, orange 95–99.5%, red < 95%.
panels.title: Predict success rate / SLA

panels.description: Number of features currently flagged as drifted (PSI > 0.12 AND (KS p < 0.05 OR Z-score > 1.5)). 0 = model input distribution is stable.
